questions.q: What happened to Ummu Jamil when she looked for the Prophet SAW?
options: Allah veiled her sight from him
She got lost in the desert
questions.explain: Allah protected His Messenger by veiling Ummu Jamil's sight so she could not see him.

questions.q: Who was the only one at the second feast to say he would follow the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: At the second feast everyone was silent, and Ali said he would follow.

questions.q: On which hill did the Prophet SAW call all of Makkah?
questions.explain: He called all of Makkah on Mount Safa and Abu Lahab insulted him.

questions.q: What does As-Sadiq, a title of the Prophet SAW, mean?
questions.explain: As-Sadiq means the ever-truthful. His people admitted he never lied.

questions.q: Why was Abu Lahab called by that name?
options: Because his face was red like a blazing fire
Because he was good at making fire
Because he lived near a volcano
questions.explain: Abu Lahab means father of the blazing flame, because his face was ruddy.

questions.q: Who was Surah Al-Masad revealed about?
questions.explain: Allah revealed that surah about Abu Lahab and his wife.

questions.q: What mocking name did Ummu Jamil use for Muhammad?
questions.explain: Mudhammam means the reviled, Ummu Jamil's mocking name.

questions.q: What did Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas strike the disturber with who interrupted the prayer?
questions.explain: Sa'd was the first to shed blood in defence of the religion.

questions.q: What was the Arqam house used for?
options: A secret centre for learning and worship
questions.explain: That hidden house became the centre where Muslims learned and worshipped.

questions.q: Abu Lahab's wealth could not save him from punishment.
questions.explain: True. Surah Al-Masad says his wealth and what he earned would not benefit him.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Only Ali answers at the second feast
Abu Lahab breaks up the first feast

questions.explain: The first feast was broken up, Ali answered at the second, the call on Safa came, Al-Masad was revealed and the Arqam house was chosen.

questions.q: A friend has lost a family member. What should we do, unlike Abu Lahab?
options: Offer condolences and pray for patience
questions.explain: We offer condolences and pray for patience, not rejoice like Abu Lahab.
